#11 [control] one word of the table metadata's quantity string
mutants.why: The string is the `quantity` description in the header of a table the generator writes. Tests read the header's resolution, orders, ground_albedo, baked_atmosphere and axes, never `quantity`, and the suite never regenerates the full table whose committed digest this wording would change. Inert over everything the suite reaches; it would matter only to someone regenerating the table, who must then re-pin the digest.

mutants.label: X6 [control] default_table() reloads and re-validates on every call
mutants.why: The @cache only saves the load. A cold default_table() (read, SHA-256, decode, log of 468k values) measured about 3 ms on the review machine, so every call that now reloads stays far under the speed tests' 50 ms and 10 s limits, and every functional assertion is unchanged. Inert over the suite; it would matter only if the load cost grew past those limits or a caller relied on the object being shared (no test asserts identity).
